Every retreat is bespoke and fully tailored to you. We work holistically across all key areas of your life and wellbeing to create deep, lasting change.
Your program is designed to support:
360 wellness and physical health optimisation
weight management and body confidence
detox and cleansing
stress reduction and burnout recovery

nervous system regulation
lifestyle and habit transformation
We look at the whole picture, not just symptoms.
Health, mindset, emotions, habits, relationships and lifestyle are all addressed in an integrated way.
Everything is delivered privately, one on one, by your dedicated expert team, ensuring complete discretion and personalised care at every level.

You are supported by elite specialists in biochemistry, nutrition, movement, emotional wellbeing, and holistic therapies, working together to create rapid yet sustainable results. No generic schedules. No group classes.
Just your own private program, designed around your goals, energy, and lifestyle.

At Alive, this is not a spa holiday with a few wellness extras, it is a complete executive level reset for all life areas where you can find yourself again, rest deeply and for once... be fully supported with nothing to do accept surrender and let us care deeply for you.
Expect renewed clarity, restored energy, healthier habits, and a profound shift in how you live, lead, and feel.
This is where high achievers and those accustomed to the very best come to reclaim their health, power, and purpose.
